entries.name: HRS-1596
entries.stage: Phase I registered; not yet recruiting in the reviewed registry
entries.summary: Hengrui describes HRS-1596 as a GLP-1/GIP dual agonist being developed as a potential once-weekly oral treatment. ClinicalTrials.gov lists a Chinese Phase I study as not yet recruiting. Hengrui announced a proposed licence to Novo Nordisk outside Greater China; closing had not been confirmed by the reviewed evidence.

entries.ukAuthorisation: No UK marketing authorisation is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.nhsEngland: No NHS access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: No lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock is established. Trial registration and a licence agreement are not supply.
entries.limitations: Early-stage sponsor and registry evidence only. The trial is not yet recruiting, the proposed weekly dosing has not been established as an approved regimen, and the licence transaction remained subject to closing conditions.

entries.name: Emugrobart (GYM329 / RO7204239)
entries.stage: Obesity development discontinued after Phase II interim assessment
entries.summary: Chugai says Roche discontinued obesity development of the anti-latent-myostatin antibody after an interim assessment of the Phase II GYMINDA combination study made its pre-specified clinically meaningful weight-loss objective unlikely. Rights are being returned to Chugai; possible work in spinal muscular atrophy is a separate indication.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06965413 (GYMINDA)
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Trial registry read for evidence; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.ukAuthorisation: No UK marketing authorisation is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.nhsEngland: No NHS routine access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: No lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock is established. UK trial sites were research locations and do not establish supply.
entries.limitations: The sponsor announcement reports the interim conclusion but does not publish complete trial results. The registry had not yet reflected the later discontinuation notice, and its estimated overall completion remained in 2027.

entries.name: ENV-308
entries.summary: Enveda describes ENV-308 as an investigational once-daily oral small molecule designed to mimic Lac-Phe and support weight and metabolic maintenance after GLP-1 treatment. The reported first-human study assessed safety, tolerability and drug behaviour in healthy volunteers; it did not test weight loss, body composition or post-GLP-1 maintenance. A Phase II maintenance study is planned.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The sponsor says ENV-308 is not approved by any regulatory authority; no UK marketing authorisation is established.
entries.nhsEngland: No NHS access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: No lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock is established. Early clinical research is not supply.
entries.limitations: Human evidence is limited to the sponsor's Phase I summary in healthy volunteers. Human weight-maintenance, body-composition and lean-mass outcomes have not been demonstrated in the reviewed evidence, Phase II is only planned, and no matching ClinicalTrials.gov record was found.

sources.title: Hengrui and Novo licence agreement for HRS-1596
sources.assessment: Hengrui describes HRS-1596 as phase I-ready, with potential for once-weekly oral dosing, and says it has Chinese approval to initiate Phase I research for weight management and type 2 diabetes. The proposed Novo licence excludes Greater China and remained subject to closing conditions expected in Q4 2026. Potential dosing and expected transaction closing are not completed events.

sources.title: Chugai: discontinuation of emugrobart obesity development
sources.assessment: Chugai says Roche will end all future development of emugrobart for obesity and return the licensed rights. It attributes the decision to a comprehensive assessment including an interim Phase II GYMINDA analysis, which made the pre-specified clinically meaningful weight-loss objective unlikely. It reports tolerability and no new safety signal, but that does not establish efficacy, approval, access or supply. Chugai's separate preparation to resume work in spinal muscular atrophy does not continue the obesity programme.

sources.title: Enveda: Phase 1 ENV-308 results and planned post-GLP-1 study
requiredTerms: not approved for use by any regulatory authority
sources.assessment: Enveda reports Phase I safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetic and exploratory leptin observations in 88 healthy adult volunteers. The company explicitly says the study was not designed to detect body-weight or metabolic outcomes and that weight, body-composition and maintenance effects are for future trials. Lean-muscle preservation and prevention of weight regain are preclinical findings, not demonstrated human benefits. Phase II post-GLP-1 maintenance research is planned, not initiated or completed in this source.

sourceReplacement.title: Zealand Pharma: ZUPREME-1 publication and Phase 3 programme status
sourceReplacement.evidenceType: original sponsor release distributed by GlobeNewswire
sourceReplacement.assessment: The sponsor release reports publication of the completed Phase II ZUPREME-1 results and says three global Phase III registrational trials are under way. It is consistent with the existing live Phase III summary and therefore does not justify a live claim change. It is a newly readable candidate source for editorial replacement of the currently delayed 22 September monitoring URL; changing the monitored source still requires review and must not renew unrelated dates.

limitations: Historical discovery receipts remain proposal records. This dated decision authorises informational publication, not clinical approval. Registry timing conflicts and ENV-308 missing registry remain visible. Unrelated source dates and failures are unchanged.
